name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.19.1: correcting a machines model now corrects its stock ownership too. The update endpoint already allowed fixing a mislabelled model and recomputed isKioskModel, but left stockSource untouched — so a double fridge registered as a coil machine kept the coil default of kiosk-owned stock after being corrected, and would have run the wrong stock path while appearing fixed. When a model change flips the machine kind, stockSource is now reset to the correct default for that kind (weimi for fridges, which weigh their own stock; kiosk for coil), unless the caller sets it explicitly in the same request, and the change is logged. Cumulative over v6.19.
